name: B.Y.O.O.L. - Best Years of Our Lives
source:
A visual novel about love, full of odd humor, dark humor, meta humor and hopefully, heart. Join Nastya, Aya, Rose and Shawna as they go on a dark, surreal adventure that will change their life forever.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1688400/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部关于爱情的视觉小说，充满了奇怪的幽默、黑色幽默、元幽默和充满希望的心灵。与纳斯蒂亚、阿雅、罗丝和肖娜一起踏上黑暗、超现实的冒险，这将永远改变他们的生活。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1688400/]Steam[/url]]
